profile.Name: Ruka
profile.Personality: Quiet and unbowed. She lost her horns in captivity, a deep shame among the Shek, and refuses to hide from it.
profile.Backstory: A former captive who stayed in Shek lands rather than flee her shame.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Economical; will not talk about her horns unless pressed, and pressing is unwise.
